content.text: The cause is direct: neither screen installs an `Escape` listener. The lockpicker has only pointer/backdrop and button cancellation, while sleep has only the Cancel button; the global input router is intentionally blocked during modal UI, so `Esc` never reaches a fallback handler. I’m adding capture-phase handlers local to each screen, with cleanup tied to the existing lifecycle.
